Every day, over 70,000 cubic meters of water are provided to the Gaza Strip through multiple water lines and desalination facilities, exceeding the benchmark for a population’s water needs. COGAT continuously works with its international partners to coordinate new projects and infrastructure maintenance to enhance the local water lines, plants and wells, like this project by @UNICEF, to improve WASH conditions in Gaza. In addition to the improvement of local water sources, water tankers and other essential WASH supplies such as chlorine tabs are brought into Gaza through COGAT’s coordination, supplying water where needed according to our local partners and sources on the ground. COGAT remains committed to facilitating projects that improve humanitarian conditions and ensuring water reaches Gazan civilians, while preventing Hamas from exploiting the water infrastructure for its own interests, as has been proven in the past.

Represented by the Ministry of Interior, the UAE has been elevated to Dialogue Partner status within ASEANAPOL, the regional body that promotes police cooperation among the member states of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations. As part of the ongoing effort to ensure a stable and continuous water supply for civilians across the Gaza Strip, COGAT reached out directly to Gazan residents through its Arabic-language social media page and asked them to report locations where additional water deliveries were needed. Following the many responses received from the civilian population, COGAT reviewed the requests and coordinated with local and international partners to dispatch water tankers to the relevant areas. This direct channel of communication helps identify specific needs on the ground and enables a faster and more focused humanitarian response. COGAT remains committed to facilitating humanitarian assistance in coordination with the international community and in direct contact with the public, to help ensure that aid reaches the civilians who need it most.
